# git-github

General Antigravity plugin for safe, practical Git and GitHub development workflows.

## Target Technology and Version

- Technology: Git/GitHub
- Version: general
- Release line: version-agnostic

This plugin intentionally avoids exact-version Git behavior, GitHub Enterprise Server release behavior, and GitHub REST API version-specific automation. Create a version-specific plugin when exact Git, GitHub API, GitHub Enterprise Server, or GitHub MCP server compatibility matters.

## Purpose

Use this plugin to help agents work safely with Git repositories and GitHub-hosted collaboration workflows. It emphasizes repository state awareness, small reversible changes, pull request quality, pre-push review discipline, safe branch and history operations, issue-to-PR collaboration, maintainer handoffs, release readiness, rollback planning, and secret-safe GitHub integration.

## What Is Included

```text
git-github/
├── plugin.json
├── README.md
├── LICENSE
├── hooks.json
├── mcp_config.json
├── rules/
│   ├── git-github-general-branching-and-history.md
│   ├── git-github-general-collaboration-safety.md
│   ├── git-github-general-repository-safety.md
│   └── git-github-general-review-and-release.md
└── skills/
    ├── git-github-general-collaboration/
    ├── git-github-general-pull-request-review/
    ├── git-github-general-release-management/
    └── git-github-general-repository-maintenance/
```

## Separation From Repository-Level Meta Plugins

This plugin owns Git and GitHub-specific collaboration behavior:

- Git branches, merges, rebases, tags, and repository state
- GitHub issues and pull requests
- GitHub review requests and maintainer handoffs
- GitHub MCP setup and boundaries
- GitHub release and hotfix coordination
- collecting PR-style diffs before branch push

Keep these concerns in separate plugins:

- `repo-code-review`: vendor-neutral code review quality and pre-PR review judgment
- `repo-issue-triage`: issue intake, severity, deduplication, and prioritization across trackers
- `repo-ci-cd-release`: CI/CD and release gates that are not GitHub-specific
- `github-actions`: GitHub Actions workflow syntax, permissions, runners, caching, and security
- language/framework plugins: implementation-level review and release details

## Script Location Rule

All scripts stay inside the skill that owns them:

```text
skills/<skill-name>/scripts/
```

This plugin has scripts only under:

```text
skills/git-github-general-repository-maintenance/scripts/
```

The collaboration skill intentionally has no scripts because remote GitHub collaboration actions require human judgment and explicit approval before write actions.

## When to Use It

Use this plugin when an agent is asked to:

- inspect repository state;
- plan or review branch, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or tag operations;
- prepare a pull request;
- collect a PR-style diff before pushing;
- review a pull request or respond to review comments;
- resolve merge conflicts;
- connect a GitHub issue to a branch or pull request;
- prepare review requests, maintainer handoffs, or stale PR triage summaries;
- check release readiness;
- plan a hotfix or rollback;
- connect to GitHub through GitHub CLI or the GitHub MCP server.

## When Not to Use It

Do not use this plugin as the source of truth for:

- GitHub Actions workflow authoring or CI/CD provider configuration;
- exact GitHub REST, GraphQL, or webhook API version behavior;
- GitHub Enterprise Server administration;
- language-specific package release workflows;
- tracker-neutral issue triage across Linear, Jira, GitHub, and other systems;
- vendor-neutral code review standards already covered by `repo-code-review`;
- regulated change-management processes that already define stricter controls;
- destructive history rewriting without explicit human approval and a written rollback plan.

## Included Rules

### `git-github-general-repository-safety`

Always-on guardrails for repository state checks, secret handling, destructive Git operations, remote operations, and agent-authored changes.

### `git-github-general-branching-and-history`

Model-decision guidance for branches, merges, rebases, cherry-picks, reverts, and conflict resolution.

### `git-github-general-review-and-release`

Model-decision guidance for pull request review, release readiness, tagging, hotfixes, and rollback planning.

### `git-github-general-collaboration-safety`

Model-decision guidance for GitHub issue/PR collaboration, review requests, labels, assignees, maintainer handoffs, stale PR triage, and GitHub MCP write boundaries.

## Included Skills

### `git-github-general-repository-maintenance`

Repository state inspection, hygiene checks, branch policy planning, safe history repair planning, and local guardrail scripts.

### `git-github-general-pull-request-review`

Pull request preparation, pre-push review workflow, review, response planning, review-comment quality, and conflict resolution.

### `git-github-general-release-management`

Release readiness, release notes, tag discipline, hotfix planning, and rollback planning.

### `git-github-general-collaboration`

GitHub issue-to-PR flow, review requests, maintainer handoffs, stale PR triage, collaboration summaries, and safe GitHub MCP collaboration boundaries.

## Included Workflows

- `repository-health-check-workflow`
- `history-repair-workflow`
- `pre-pr-review-before-push-workflow`
- `pull-request-review-workflow`
- `conflict-resolution-workflow`
- `release-readiness-workflow`
- `hotfix-workflow`
- `issue-to-pr-workflow`
- `review-request-workflow`
- `maintainer-handoff-workflow`
- `stale-pr-triage-workflow`

Workflows are stored inside the related skill folders.

`pre-pr-review-before-push-workflow` collects Git diffs and invokes the vendor-neutral `repo-code-review-pre-pr-review` skill from the `repo-code-review` plugin.

## Included Resources

- `repository-health-checklist.md`
- `branch-policy-template.md`
- `pull-request-review-checklist.md`
- `review-comment-style-guide.md`
- `release-checklist.md`
- `rollback-plan-template.md`
- `collaboration-decision-matrix.md`
- `issue-pr-linking-checklist.md`
- `maintainer-handoff-template.md`

## Included Examples

- `safe-history-rewrite-plan.md`
- `protected-branch-settings.md`
- `pull-request-description-template.md`
- `review-summary-example.md`
- `release-notes-template.md`
- `hotfix-branch-plan.md`
- `issue-to-pr-summary.md`
- `review-request-message.md`
- `maintainer-status-update.md`

## Included Scripts

Scripts are intentionally scoped to the repository-maintenance skill:

- `skills/git-github-general-repository-maintenance/scripts/inspect-repo-state.sh`
- `skills/git-github-general-repository-maintenance/scripts/git-command-guard.py`

Run scripts with `--help` before using them. Scripts are safe by default and avoid destructive operations.

No scripts were added to `git-github-general-collaboration`.

## Included MCP Servers

### `github`

The `mcp_config.json` includes a disabled-by-default GitHub MCP server definition using GitHub's official MCP server container image.

Before enabling it:

1. Review the server's official documentation.
2. Create a fine-grained token or approved GitHub App/OAuth path with the minimum required permissions.
3. Set `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` outside the repository.
4. Keep `GITHUB_TOOLSETS` narrow.
5. Remove or adjust `disabledTools` only after a human confirms the desired write capabilities.

## Included Hooks

### `git-github-general-dangerous-git-command-guard`

A `PreToolUse` hook for `run_command` that calls:

```text
.agents/plugins/git-github/skills/git-github-general-repository-maintenance/scripts/git-command-guard.py
```

It asks for explicit confirmation before risky Git operations such as force pushes, hard resets, destructive cleans, tag deletions, and history rewrite commands. It denies obvious attempts to expose GitHub tokens through shell output.

The hook command uses `python3`. On Windows or environments where the executable is named differently, change `python3` to `python` or `py` in `hooks.json`.

## Setup Instructions

1. Copy this plugin into:

```text
.agents/plugins/git-github/
```

2. Ensure the consuming repository also has:

```text
AGENTS.md
.agents/plugins/_INDEX.md
```

3. Review `hooks.json` before enabling hooks.

4. Review `mcp_config.json` and `.env.example` before enabling the GitHub MCP server.

5. Ensure Python 3 is available as `python3` if hooks are enabled.

6. To manually inspect repository state:

```bash
bash .agents/plugins/git-github/skills/git-github-general-repository-maintenance/scripts/inspect-repo-state.sh
```

7. To inspect hook usage:

```bash
python3 .agents/plugins/git-github/skills/git-github-general-repository-maintenance/scripts/git-command-guard.py --help
```

8. Pair this plugin with `repo-code-review` when using the pre-PR review workflow.

## Required Environment Variables

Only needed if enabling the GitHub MCP server or using GitHub CLI automation:

| Variable | Required | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Optional | Token for the local GitHub MCP server. Use minimum permissions. |
| `GITHUB_HOST` | Optional | GitHub Enterprise host, for example `https://github.example.com`. |
| `GITHUB_TOOLSETS` | Optional | Narrow GitHub MCP toolsets, for example `repos,issues,pull_requests`. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Optional | GitHub CLI or automation token where appropriate. |
| `GH_HOST` | Optional | GitHub CLI default host for GitHub Enterprise. |
| `GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` | Optional | GitHub CLI automation token for GitHub Enterprise. |

Never commit tokens or generated local MCP configs containing tokens.

## Compatibility Notes

- General plugin content is intentionally conservative.
- Do not assume a specific default branch name; detect it from the repository or GitHub settings.
- Do not assume a repository uses squash, merge, or rebase merge by default.
- Do not assume commit signing, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, required checks, or linear history are enabled.
- For GitHub API work, set an explicit supported API version in integration code and verify compatibility in a version-specific plugin.
- For GitHub Enterprise Server, confirm server release capabilities before using GitHub.com-oriented guidance.

## Maintenance Notes

- Keep this plugin focused on Git/GitHub collaboration and repository safety.
- Add separate plugins for GitHub Actions, GitHub Advanced Security, semantic-release, release-please, Renovate, Dependabot, or project-specific release automation.
- Keep tracker-neutral issue triage in `repo-issue-triage`.
- Keep vendor-neutral code review behavior in `repo-code-review`.
- Keep hooks safe and conservative. Destructive operations must require explicit approval.
- Keep scripts inside skill folders.
- Update `plugin.json`, this README, and `.agents/plugins/_INDEX.md` whenever files are added, renamed, or removed.
